Billing.calculateSubtitle: Upload the MISA inventory ledger, pick a contract and month, and rent is calculated per voucher.
Billing.step1Hint: Inventory detail ledger, warehouse «All», .xlsx. You can upload two monthly files (e.g. August + September).
Billing.dropHere: Drop MISA files here or click to choose
Billing.dropHint: .xlsx files, up to 10MB each, up to 6 at a time
Billing.noFilesForPeriod: No MISA file has data for {from} – {to} yet. Upload one alongside.
Billing.coversPeriod: The selected files cover the whole period.
Billing.notCoveringPeriod: The selected files don't cover the whole period (or aren't consecutive). The calculation will stop with an error.
Billing.addCodesToContract: Add these codes to the contract
Billing.contractHasNoItems: This contract has no price lines yet.
Billing.noContractsYet: No contracts yet. Create a contract and its prices first.
Billing.deleteDraftBody: Delete this draft calculation? This can't be undone.

Billing.voidBody: It becomes Voided (kept in history). Another calculation can then be confirmed for this period.
Billing.warningsTitle: {count, plural, one {# warning to check} other {# warnings to check}}
Billing.historySubtitle: Saved calculations by contract and period.
Billing.uploadsSubtitle: Uploaded inventory detail ledgers. Files are read and checked on upload.
Billing.howToExport1: Open the inventory detail ledger report and choose warehouse «All».
Billing.howToExport2: Choose a custom period from the 26th of the previous month to the 25th of the billing month (one file), or export two monthly files.
Billing.howToExport3: Export to Excel and upload the .xlsx here. Both 13- and 16-column layouts work.
Billing.deleteFileBody: Delete "{name}"? Files used by a confirmed calculation can't be deleted.
Billing.contractsSubtitle: Each contract maps to one MISA project warehouse, with daily rent prices.
Billing.misaKhoHint: Exactly as the "Mã kho: …" line in the MISA file.
Billing.periodStartDayHint: TP uses 26: the 26th of the previous month to the 25th.
Billing.deleteContractBody: Delete contract {name}? Contracts with calculations can't be deleted; set them inactive instead.
Billing.pricesSubtitle: Each line is one line on the payment dossier. Several MISA codes can be merged into one line (comma-separated).
Billing.contractRangesSubtitle: Company-wide ranges (like Tết) are managed under Non-billable days.
Billing.pendingCodesNote: Added new lines for undeclared codes: {codes}. Fill in name and price, or move the codes to an existing line / the not-billed list, then Save.
Billing.excludedCodesHint: Codes in the project warehouse that are not charged (pallets…), comma-separated.
Billing.rangesSubtitle: Date ranges not charged, e.g. Tết holidays. Each voucher line loses the days overlapping these ranges.
Billing.deleteRangeBody: Delete the non-billable range {from} – {to}? Saved calculations don't change.
Billing.rangeHint: Applies to calculations made after adding it. Saved calculations don't change.
Billing.modeMonthHint: The 26 → 25 period used for payment dossiers. Only period calculations can be confirmed.
Billing.modeRangeHint: Quick look at any date range. Saved as a draft and exportable, but can't be confirmed.
Billing.chooseValidRange: Choose a valid date range (start not after end).
Billing.customRangeNote: Custom date range (not a billing period)
Billing.rangeNotConfirmable: Date-range calculations are for reference only and can't be confirmed. For a payment dossier, calculate by billing period.
Billing.errNotConfirmable: Only drafts calculated by billing period can be confirmed.
Billing.demoBanner: Assumed prices – not for payment dossiers. This contract is only for comparing with the Excel tool.
Billing.fractionalBanner: Some items have fractional quantities, so amounts are not whole numbers (see warnings below). Usually a raw material sits in the rental warehouse by mistake. Check that item code in the contract and recalculate. The draft is kept but can't be confirmed.
Billing.errDemoNotConfirmable: Demo contract: prices are for comparison only and can't be confirmed.
Billing.errFractionalNotConfirmable: This calculation has fractional quantities and can't be confirmed yet. Check that item code and recalculate.
Billing.compareSubtitle: Calculate every demo contract (prices from the Excel tool's DATA ĐƠN GIÁ sheet) for a date range, to check against the BÁO CÁO TIỀN THUÊ sheet.
Billing.compareBanner: Demo data – only for comparing the two systems, never for payment dossiers. {count} demo contracts. This page only calculates; nothing is saved.
Billing.compareHint: No non-billable days are applied (the Excel tool has none). The MISA files must cover the whole range.
Billing.errNoDemoContracts: No demo contracts yet. Run npm run seed:gia-dinh first.
Billing.errCompareNotCovered: The selected MISA files only cover {fileFrom} – {fileTo}, not the whole chosen range.
